name: Reel Factory: Telegram Bot
description: The reel factory's own Telegram bot: /remake, /reel, /reels, /refs, /audience, /status, product photos, and every Approve / Start / Keep tap of a reel job (saved in dtj_bot_answers).

nodes.name: Telegram Message
nodes.notes: Starts on every message, photo and button tap sent to the DTJ reel bot (one to one chats only).

nodes.name: Read the Message
nodes.notes: Works out what the person wants: a tap or typed answer for a reel job, a product photo, /remake, /reel, /reels N, /refs, /audience, /status or help. Never uses a message that looks like a password or key.

nodes.name: Is It a Button?
nodes.notes: A button tap? Then the tapped button's loading spinner is stopped (next node).

nodes.name: Answer the Button
nodes.notes: Tells Telegram the tap was received, so the button stops spinning.

nodes.name: Load Bot Users
nodes.notes: The DTJ team list (dtj_bot_users, active people only). Only they may use the bot; admins may change the limit.

nodes.name: Load Open Questions
nodes.notes: Questions a reel job is waiting on in this chat (open marks in dtj_bot_answers): a plain message answers the open one.

nodes.name: Load Recent Photos
nodes.notes: Product photos this person sent to the bot (dtj_bot_answers, job reelpics-<chat>); the last 30 minutes count.

nodes.name: Load Today's Reels
nodes.notes: Reels asked for today (dtj_reel_jobs, since midnight India time), for the daily limit and /status.

nodes.name: Load Settings
nodes.notes: The bot's settings (dtj_reel_settings): the daily reel limit set with /reels N (10 when never set).

nodes.name: Who Is It
nodes.notes: Decides what happens: answer, photo, new reel (unless today's limit is used), limit, reference search, or a reply (help, status, a refusal with the reason). Unknown people get their Telegram number to send Harsh.

nodes.name: What to Do
nodes.notes: Sends each request down its own path; everything else goes straight to Send.

nodes.name: Save the Answer
nodes.notes: Saves the tap or typed answer in dtj_bot_answers (job, key, value, who, when), where the VPS worker, reel_job.py and Find References read it. An Approve is that person's yes for that one step only.

nodes.name: Say What Happened
nodes.notes: One short message saying what was done (or that it failed, so nothing is lost silently).

nodes.name: Save the Photo
nodes.notes: Keeps the photo's Telegram file id, so the next /remake or /reel uses it as a product picture (downloaded on the VPS).

nodes.name: Start New Reel
nodes.notes: Starts Reel Factory: New Reel with the request (remake or UGC) and does not wait: the VPS worker asks 'tap Start if you are watching' in this chat.

nodes.name: Save the Limit
nodes.notes: Saves today's reel limit (key daily_limit in dtj_reel_settings) with who set it and when.

nodes.name: Start Find References
nodes.notes: Starts Reel Factory: Find References (/refs: winning reels of a brand; /audience: what an audience watches) and does not wait; it sends its results to this chat.

nodes.name: Send
nodes.notes: Sends the reply in this chat through the DTJ reel bot.
